method: All ten PNG files inspected using view_image at original detail; numerical data separately independently audited.
checks: all ten figures and thirty panels reviewed
five comparators and both policy references retained
all-six variant gains show unchanged-control drift without normalization
full trial ranges and four realization markers visible
wall and CPU charts have matching corresponding axis bounds
titles, units, legends and captions visible without clipping or overlap
absolute timings and losing comparisons retained
limitations: Standalone figure QA; embedding in a report needs page-scale legibility review.
Descriptive ranges are not confidence intervals; two sizes do not establish persistence.
